questions.question: Discuss the contamination and spoilage of cereal products. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss the contamination and spoilage of cereal products. (CO1 / An)
  • Ans:
  • o Contamination: insects, mites, dust, fungi
  • o Spoilage: mould growth, rancidity, insect infestation
  • o Causes: moisture, poor storage
  • o Effects: off-odour, discoloration, nutrient loss
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
